job_title: Software Engineer / Java Full Stack Developer
description_text:
Role Overview: HCLTech is seeking a Software Engineer to design, develop, and maintain high-performance enterprise applications.

Key Qualifications & Requirements:
- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent.
- Required: Strong programming expertise in Java and Spring Boot framework.
- 2+ years experience designing and consuming REST APIs and microservices.
- Required: Solid understanding of relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL and SQL queries.
- Hands-on experience with Git version control.

Preferred Skills:
- Experience with frontend frameworks like React or Angular is preferred.
- Knowledge of Docker containers and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
- Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS or Azure) is a bonus.

Overview: HCLTech is hiring Cloud & DevOps Engineers to automate cloud infrastructure and streamline continuous deployment.

Key Requirements:
- Required: Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure.
- Required: Proficiency in Linux systems administration and scripting using Python or Bash.
- Experience deploying and managing Docker containers and Kubernetes clusters.
- Experience setting up automated CI/CD pipelines using Git.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Terraform infrastructure as code is a plus.
- Knowledge of monitoring tools and distributed microservices.

About the Role: Infosys is looking for talented Systems Engineers to build next-generation enterprise digital platforms.

Requirements:
- Required: Proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language: Java, Python, or C++.
- Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, and software design principles.
- Required: Practical experience with SQL and relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
- Familiarity with Git version control systems.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with REST APIs and web services.
- Exposure to cloud technologies like AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), or Azure.
- Understanding of automated unit testing and agile development methodologies.

Job Description: Wipro is hiring Project Engineers to deliver scalable full stack solutions for global customers.

Technical Qualifications:
- Required: Strong proficiency in JavaScript and React for modern interactive web applications.
- Required: Experience building backend APIs using Node.js or Python.
- Practical experience writing SQL queries with MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Git for code collaboration.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Hands-on experience with Docker and automated CI/CD.
- Familiarity with Next.js or TypeScript is a plus.
- Knowledge of cloud deployment on AWS or Azure.

Role Overview: Cognizant is looking for Programmer Analysts to design and implement robust enterprise services.

Mandatory Skills:
- Required: Solid programming proficiency in Java, Spring Boot, or Python.
- Required: Experience with REST API design, architecture, and documentation.
- Strong proficiency in SQL with PostgreSQL or MySQL relational databases.
- Experience with Git version control.

Desirable Skills:
- Experience with Docker containerization and Kubernetes is preferred.
- Exposure to Amazon Web Services (AWS) or Microsoft Azure cloud.
- Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.

Job Summary: Accenture is hiring Associate Software Engineers to join technology delivery teams.

Key Responsibilities & Qualifications:
- Required: Strong foundational programming skills in Java, Python, or C#.
- Required: Hands-on experience with SQL and relational database concepts.
- Good understanding of software engineering fundamentals and Git.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with web technologies such as React or Angular.
- Understanding of cloud fundamentals across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- Knowledge of agile methodologies and DevOps practices.

Job Description: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is hiring Software Engineers.

Role Requirements:
- Required: Strong programming expertise in Java, Python, or C++.
- Required: Solid experience in relational databases and SQL queries (Oracle, MySQL, or PostgreSQL).
- Experience with REST API development and integration.
- Familiarity with Linux command line and Git.

Preferred Skills:
- Experience with Spring Boot or microservices architecture.
- Exposure to Docker and cloud computing platforms (AWS or Azure).

Role Overview: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is hiring a Data Analyst to deliver business intelligence and analytics solutions for enterprise clients.

Key Requirements:
- Required: Proficiency in SQL for complex data extraction and transformation.
- Required: Hands-on experience with Python, Pandas, and NumPy for data manipulation.
- 2+ years experience building interactive dashboards using Power BI or Tableau.
- Working knowledge of relational databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.

Preferred Skills:
- Knowledge of Machine Learning fundamentals and Scikit-Learn is a bonus.
- Experience with Apache Spark or cloud data warehouses is preferred.

About the Job: As a Software Engineer at Google, you will build large-scale distributed systems and high-throughput backend services.

Minimum qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
- 2+ years of software development experience with Python, Go, C++, or Java.
- Required: Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems.
- Experience with Linux environments and Git version control.

Preferred qualifications:
- Experience with Kubernetes and Docker containers is a plus.
- Experience deploying services on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS.
- Experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.

Overview: We are looking for a Software Engineer to join Azure Core Engineering to design resilient cloud infrastructure.

Required Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical discipline.
- 2+ years programming experience in C#, .NET, C++, or Python.
- Experience building REST APIs and microservices.
- Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure cloud platform.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Docker and Kubernetes is preferred.
- Hands-on experience with CI/CD deployment pipelines.
- Experience working with SQL and relational databases.

Job Description: Amazon is seeking an innovative Software Development Engineer (SDE) to build highly scalable backend services.

Basic Qualifications:
- 2+ years of non-internship professional software development experience.
- Required: Programming experience with at least one modern language such as Java, Python, or Go.
- Experience with object-oriented design and distributed microservices architecture.
- Strong knowledge of Git and Linux operating systems.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Hands-on experience with Amazon Web Services (AWS) ecosystem.
- Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and automated CI/CD.
- Experience with NoSQL or DynamoDB/MongoDB and PostgreSQL.

About Stripe: Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for the internet.

Requirements:
- 3+ years experience building scalable backend services.
- Strong proficiency in Python, Go, or Ruby is required.
- Required: Experience working with PostgreSQL and relational database performance.
- Experience designing and maintaining public-facing REST APIs.
- Experience with Docker and microservices architecture is preferred.

About the Role: Meta is looking for Frontend Software Engineers to develop interactive web applications used by billions of people.

Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent.
- 2+ years experience with modern JavaScript, TypeScript, and HTML/CSS.
- Required: Deep expertise in React and component-driven state architecture.
- Experience integrating REST APIs and GraphQL endpoints.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Next.js and frontend performance optimization.
- Familiarity with CI/CD and modern web build tooling.

Overview: Deloitte is seeking a Technology Analyst to join our Consulting Practice to deliver business analytics and intelligence solutions.

Key Qualifications:
- Required: Advanced proficiency in SQL for data extraction, joining tables, and complex queries.
- Required: Practical experience in Python using Pandas for data manipulation and quantitative analysis.
- Required: Hands-on experience developing interactive management dashboards using Power BI or Tableau.
- Required: Advanced analytical problem solving and data modeling in Excel.
- Good understanding of relational databases and Git version control.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Exposure to cloud analytics platforms (AWS or Azure).
- Familiarity with business process modeling and agile delivery.

Overview: Deloitte is hiring Software Engineers to develop enterprise application architectures.

Core Requirements:
- Required: Strong programming proficiency in modern languages (Python or Java).
- Required: Practical experience building and consuming REST APIs and web services.
- Required: Solid foundation in relational databases and SQL query development (PostgreSQL or MySQL).
- Required: Version control proficiency with Git.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Docker containerization and CI/CD deployment pipelines.
- Exposure to cloud technologies on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
- Understanding of microservices and system design.

About the Role: Mastercard is seeking a Software Engineer to develop secure payment processing solutions and distributed backend systems.

Key Requirements:
- Required: Strong programming foundation in modern object-oriented languages (Java or Python).
- Required: Hands-on experience designing and implementing secure REST APIs and microservices.
- Required: Solid understanding of SQL and relational database systems (PostgreSQL, Oracle, or MySQL).
- Required: Experience with Git version control systems and Linux environments.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience with Spring Boot or FastAPI frameworks.
- Experience with Docker containers and Kubernetes.
- Familiarity with payment card security standards and distributed messaging.

Role Overview: Mastercard is hiring a Data Analyst to extract business insights from payment network transactions.

Qualifications:
- Required: Advanced proficiency in SQL for querying large relational datasets and performance tuning.
- Required: Practical experience in Python with Pandas for data transformation and statistical analysis.
- Required: Hands-on experience building visual reports and executive dashboards in Tableau or Power BI.
- Required: Advanced spreadsheet analysis with Excel.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Familiarity with big data technologies like Apache Spark.
- Basic understanding of Machine Learning concepts.

Job Summary: Accenture is seeking a Data Analyst to join our Data & Analytics practice.

Key Requirements:
- Required: Advanced SQL querying skills across relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, or SQL Server).
- Required: Practical programming experience in Python for data cleaning, Pandas, and analysis.
- Required: Hands-on experience developing business intelligence dashboards using Power BI or Tableau.
- Required: Strong analytical modeling skills with Excel.
- Good understanding of version control with Git.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Exposure to cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, AWS, or Azure).
- Familiarity with predictive modeling and statistics.
